option_relations.rationale: Epidermolytic ichthyosis is also known as bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma and epidermolytic hyperkeratosis. The option is a direct synonym for the provided leaf.
Superficial epidermolytic ichthyosis is a rare variant of epidermolytic ichthyosis (epidermolytic hyperkeratosis).
Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens is a distinct genetic disorder from epidermolytic hyperkeratosis, though both are bullous ichthyoses. It is caused by mutations in KRT2, not KRT1.
Annular epidermolytic ichthyosis (AEI) is a clinical subtype of epidermolytic ichthyosis (epidermolytic hyperkeratosis).
